name: No Man's Sky

start.note: from the start to the title screen; flat first (VXRT_FLAT=1), Vulkan only on PC

summary.ja: Steam の DRM ラッパー（SteamStub、NMS.exe の .bind 部）が Windows 版 Steam クライアントの共有メモリ Local\SteamStart_SharedMemFile を探し、無いので「Application load error 3:0000065558」で止まる。ゲーム本体のコードと Vulkan には届いていない。
summary.en: Steam's DRM wrapper (SteamStub, the .bind section of NMS.exe) looks for the Windows Steam client's shared memory Local\SteamStart_SharedMemFile and stops with "Application load error 3:0000065558" without it. The game's own code and Vulkan are not reached.

known_issues.summary: Flat runs on 2026-10-23 (scripts/launch_vxrt_game.sh with VXRT_FLAT=1, buildid 25732212): the SteamStub stub first needed msvcrt.dll!vsprintf (an int3 loop at NMS.exe+0x76e60ec when GetProcAddress failed) and RegisterTraceGuidsW; with both, steam_api64's SteamAPI_Init loads the Steam bridge (SteamClient017/014 created), then the stub opens the event and file mapping Local\SteamStart_SharedMemFile of a Windows Steam client, finds none and shows "Steam Error: Application load error 3:0000065558". Answering that Windows Steam client protocol ourselves would mean imitating Steam's DRM, which the rules forbid (AGENTS.md).

notes: Vulkan only on PC (the game carries the Khronos loader vulkan-1.dll; VXRuntime's built-in vulkan-1.dll is used instead). Also carries openvr_api.dll, DLSS/XeSS/Streamline, PlayFab/Party, NVIDIA Aftermath; no anti-cheat.
VXRT_DEBUGGER=0 is not needed for the stub's check (it failed the same way with and without).
